recordStage: Owner release recorded; the owner has not yet seen these frames in the app. Project verification, the owner's look, CI and merge remain separate gates.

approval.instruction: On 2026-11-12, looking at Home's Pull A card, the owner wrote: "We need a front view of the deadlift, rather than back view, just looks weird do we have one ?", then: "Need to generate a front version of the deadlift and replace the backwards one for the lifting pull day, maybe for the instruction as well for the form and if it is one of the videos generated for home then that as well."
approval.context: The released set (2026-10-14) was drawn from a rear-oblique camera, so Home's hero on a deadlift day showed the athlete from behind. This redraw keeps the house style (the canonical athlete, the violet key, no clothing, black stage) and the six cues, and turns the camera to the front three-quarter the trap-bar deadlift already uses.

provenance.method: gemini-3-pro-image through scripts/art/gemini-image.py at 2048 px square. A master (bar on the floor) with the canonical athlete, the trap-bar deadlift for the camera and the old floor frame for the pose; a colour-only edit of the master; the knee position drawn fresh with the trap-bar camera and the old knee frame; the lockout drawn with the master attached. 42 calls, 4 used. build.py moves the knee drawing up 38 px (measured at the near shoe), scales the violet to #7B72E9, clamps near-black to black, crops all three drawings the same and resamples them once to 1080x1080. Nothing was drawn by hand.

findings: Three positions, not six: bar on the floor (frames 1, 2), bar at the knees (3, 6) and lockout (4, 5), the same order and cue timings as the 2026-10-14 set.

The knee drawing is a separate generation from the other two. Its near shoe was registered to theirs (38 px up, no scale), but its plates are drawn 2% smaller than the start's and the lockout's 5% smaller, so the plates change size a little between frames.
The lockout is turned a little more square-on than the start: the start shows more of the near hip, the lockout more of the chest.

From the front most of the glutes and hamstrings face away, so the violet is a band on the buttock and the back edge of the thigh, widest in the set-up and thinnest at lockout. The spinal erectors, which the key names as secondary, are not visible from this camera; the trapezius carries the lilac.

The start is a colour edit of the master: the whole visible thigh was violet in the master and is white-grey with a violet back edge in the edit. The edit is a new generation, not a mask, so fine line work may differ slightly from the master.
No anchors or bar heights were measured against the athlete; the bar path was checked by eye on an onion-skin of the three positions.

identity.evidence: Unverified. Observed: the canonical bald, faceless anatomy-v3 athlete with white trainers and a smooth, featureless pelvis in all three drawings, at native size and on the contact sheet.

camera.evidence: Unverified. Observed: one front three-quarter camera at hip height for all six frames, the body turned about 30 degrees to the picture's right, one 1080x1080 canvas and one crop. The start and lockout share the near shoe to the pixel; the knee drawing was moved 38 px up to match it. The lockout's torso is a little more square-on.

anatomy.evidence: Unverified. Observed: no extra or missing limbs at native size. Straight arms and an overhand grip outside the legs in every position; flat back in the set-up and at the knees; tall lockout without leaning back.

equipment.evidence: Unverified. Observed: one straight barbell with one grey plate on each end in every frame, the near plate larger. Plate diameters vary by up to 5% between the three drawings; the bar is each drawing's own.

contact.evidence: Unverified. Observed: both hands hold the bar in every frame and both feet are flat. No anchors were measured.

physics.evidence: Unverified. Observed: bar on the floor touching the shins with the hips above the knees; bar at the knees with the shins vertical and the back at about 45 degrees; lockout with hips and knees straight. The bar stays close to the legs on an onion-skin of the three; nothing was measured.

muscles.evidence: Unverified. Observed: glutes and hamstrings in the library's #7B72E9 (each drawing's median scaled to it), trapezius in a lighter lilac; the quadriceps are white-grey in every frame. The erectors are not visible from the front.

cueAgreement.evidence: Unverified. Observed: the six cue labels and lines are unchanged (same cue hash as the 2026-10-14 record) and the frame order is the same, so Set, Brace, Clear knees, Stand, Control and Lower each sit on the position they name.

sequenceAndLoop.evidence: Unverified. Observed: three positions in six frames, 6 to 1 returns from the knees to the floor. Reviewed as a contact sheet and an onion-skin; stepped in the player by scripts/art/check-redraw-release.mjs, not watched by a person.
